column3: Bender Library weekday hours are 08:00 to 23:00. Weekend hours start at 10:00.

text: The AU-toy shuttle stop nearest Kay Spiritual Life Center is Stop K. Midday loops run every 12 minutes.
The mascot of AU-toy is an eagle named Clawdia. Students can meet the mascot on the Quad most Fridays at noon.
Hurst Hall on AU-toy campus holds intro statistics recitations in rooms 12 and 14 on Tuesday afternoons.
The School of Public Affairs cafe on AU-toy campus sells oat lattes and closes at 16:00 on Fridays.
AU-toy Student Health is in McCabe. Flu shots are offered in the lobby during October.
The Quad sits between Bender Library and Hurst Hall. Inner paths ban cycling from 11:00 to 14:00.
Graduate DATA students on AU-toy campus book CPU time in the Kerwin lab by writing DATA 643 on the clipboard.
